messages:
daria: Heads-up — opening a small docs hotfix to add the incident/status link and a brief workaround for the token-refresh 401s we saw in the incident. tagging reviewers.

lucas: paste the status url and the exact snippet you plan to add. comms asked we avoid the word 'outage' in customer-facing text.

daria: status: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2026-11-token-refresh
Proposed short copy: "Temporary mitigation: If you experience intermittent 401s on long-lived streams after the incident, call the token-refresh endpoint and then restart your stream. This is a temporary mitigation while engineering rolls out a permanent fix."

hannah: sounds good. please include minimal examples for JS and curl so support can reference them. Also add frontmatter tag so we can filter hotfixes.

daria: adding snippets. JS (sync/async note): `await client.auth.refreshToken()` then restart stream. curl for ops: 
```
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OLD_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth/refresh \
  -d '{"grant_type":"refresh_token","refresh_token":"REPLACE_ME"}'
```

lucas: open a PR and mark it hotfix in frontmatter. include `hotfixes: ["incident-2026-11-token-refresh"]`. Also run the docs linter locally if you can — we've seen broken-link regressions in incident pages before.

daria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6342 — includes md change, snippets, and `hotfixes` frontmatter. Preview: https://deploy-preview-6342--docs.redwood.example/incident-token-refresh-mitigation

ci-bot: build started for PR #6342 (ci/docs-preview).

hannah: quick check on preview  code fences render but JS fence was missing the language tag. tiny fix incoming.

daria: pushed JS fence language.

ci-bot: build failed for PR #6342  docs-linter/links: broken link to /guides/legacy-auth (404).

support: that legacy link is deprecated and shouldn't be referenced in the hotfix. remove the anchor and keep the PR focused to the incident page only.

daria: removed the legacy link and pushed. build retriggering.

ci-bot: build succeeded for PR #6342  preview: https://deploy-preview-6342--docs.redwood.example/incident-token-refresh-mitigation

lucas: I'll review in ~25 and try to approve quickly. can we merge before overnight deploy so support has the doc for morning shift?

hannah: +1 expedited review. legal confirmed no extra review needed for this wording.

lucas: reviewed and approved. small punctuation nit fixed inline. Approving now. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: PR #6342 merged into main by daria (docs).

daria: following up to cherry-pick into `release/2026-11` and to add an internal KB link in the release branch only. @support can you add a short runbook entry with the curl/JS snippets and escalation steps?

support: Will add KB entry and paste snippets. Will link the internal KB in the cherry-pick PR (internal-only).

statusbot: Incident 2026-11 token-refresh  mitigation documented. Postmortem link (when available): https://status.redwood.example/postmortem/2026-11-token-refresh

hannah: closing loop here. If support sees variant reports, update the KB first and then we can update the public doc with any additional mitigations. Thanks all. :rocket:
